title: Stop Using Commas in Suno? I Actually Tested It
reported_observation: Author reports comparing comma-separated and pipe-separated bracket tags for falsetto, a sax solo and a breakdown. Same style and lyrics, Weirdness 0, eight generations per version. The author reports no observable difference between punctuation variants; sax appeared in all eight examples for both.
creator_interpretation: Potentially useful negative result about comma-vs-pipe myths. The experiment is self-reported and needs independent replication; the author also promotes a prompt product, which is a relevant conflict/bias note.
our_hypothesis: The lexical content inside the tag may matter more than the comma/pipe separator for those three examples, but the sample is small and narrow.
limitations: Metadata and excerpt summary from publicly accessible web results; inspect full source before promotion.
